svg.title: StayLong architecture
svg.desc: A judge-friendly view of StayLong's approval-safe ageing-in-place coordination architecture, from the older person's web experience through the public demo, bounded agentic coordination core, approval boundary and Google Cloud delivery controls.
svg.text: From a home concern to an assessment-ready plan — with the older person in control of every external action.
Built and operated on Google Cloud
Turns an everyday concern into clear,
No real MyGov, provider, payment, Calendar,
Vertex Model Garden MaaS · fail closed
Gemini 3.6 Flash prepares a bounded plan
A COORDINATION LAYER — NOT A DECISION MAKER
Does not determine eligibility, choose providers, prescribe changes or make payments.

g.text: Google Calendar · create only after approval
Gmail draft only · never sent automatically

svg.text: Built, delivered and observed on Google Cloud
Infrastructure is declared in code, deployed without long-lived cloud keys, and monitored with privacy-safe timing logs.

g.text: Cloud Run, routing and policies as code

svg.text: Public demo: anonymous sessions, synthetic data and sandbox actions. Private runtime: IAM access and user-approved OAuth only.
